basic_details.job_title: TISS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Research Interns, Research Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), a grant-in-aid institute under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, is filling 10 contract positions at its Tuljapur Off-Campus for the project "District Strategic Plan through Sectoral Integration and Capacity-Building for Sustainable Governance", run with the District Planning Office, Collector Office, Dharashiv, Maharashtra. how_to_apply: Apply online through the Google application form link provided with the advertisement.
Give your E-mail ID in the Google Application Form; it is mandatory.

Fill the Application form (Annexure-1) given on pages 5 to 7 of the notice, which asks for the post applied for, name, addresses, mobile number, date of birth, age, sex, nationality, category, examinations passed, previous employment, languages known and a declaration.
Upload a scanned copy of the Application form (Annexure-1) and a copy of your resume in a SINGLE PDF file only, at the last tab of the Google form.
Submit the form so that it is received by 29 November 2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be considered.
Wait for the e-mail: only shortlisted candidates are informed over e-mail to appear for the Personal Interaction.
Annexure-1 application form and resume, in a single PDF.
Copies of marksheet and certificate of degree courses.
Work experience certificate, if experience is stated in the application.
At the interview: XEROX copies of relevant certificates of educational qualifications, work experience and ID Proof (self attested), along with original documents for verification.
No Objection Certificate from the employer, for a candidate under employment.
The notice also lists "Two Recommendation Letters" among its other conditions.

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: TISS describes itself as a centrally funded public university operating from four campuses in Mumbai and Tuljapur in Maharashtra, Guwahati and Hyderabad. It has also expanded its education, training, research and outreach activities in several other states. The notice is issued from the Tuljapur Off-Campus (Apsinga Road, Post – Tuljapur, District – Dharashiv, Pincode – 413 601) and signed by the Project Director, TISS-Tuljapur Off-Campus.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age cut-off date is not printed in the notice. English Typewriting 30 wpm. Marathi Typewriting 30 wpm. MSCIT – Computer Literacy completed. Proficiency in word, excel and power point. Preference for candidates who have worked in short term projects. Preference for candidates with good knowledge of accounting and administrative experience. Every post requires good written and oral communication skills in Marathi and English. Preference goes to candidates with experience and proficiency in the Marathi language, particularly in writing project reports (typing project reports for the Administrative cum Account Assistant). The Institute reserves the right to relax the qualification of a candidate based on work experience, and to relax age for persons already holding comparable positions in a university or research institution of repute. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All posts are advertised "on Contract". The Research Officer, Research Associate and Research Interns receive travelling expenses during data collection by public transport on top of their pay. Research Interns without Honorarium receive no remuneration, only travelling expenses during data collection by public transport, food charges and accommodation charges. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview. The selected candidate is required to join immediately after selection.

content_sections.heading: TISS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Designing Workshop Module, writing reports and minutes of the meeting. Engage/Facilitate data collection through a focus Group Discussion/Case studies/Secondary sources from the respective Government Officials. Field visits in Dharashiv District of Maharashtra. To track advances, receipt and bill payments of travelling and food bills. To help in typing, data entry, accounting and other work. Communication to agencies/ interns/ research assistant etc. Advance settlement of projects taken for various purposes from office through erp. Communication to accounts section about advances, bill settlements, project expenses etc. Any other tasks given by project leader time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice names two stages: shortlisting of applicants, who are informed over e-mail, and a Personal Interaction (interview) at TISS, Tuljapur off-Campus. The notice does not say how candidates are shortlisted or how marks are given. Mode: the interview is conducted in offline mode. Date and time: 04 December 2026, Timing: 09.30AM. Reporting: shortlisted candidates report to Mr Kundan Dhumal, Section Officer, Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Tuljapur off-campus on the day of the interview. Venue: Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Tuljapur off-campus, Tuljapur, Dharashiv Maharashtra-413601. Contact: 9270105222 to 26. The Institute reserves the right to invite persons for interview who may not have applied as per the above procedure.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 10 posts: Research Officer 1, Research Associate 2, Research Interns 1, Research Interns without Honorarium 5 and Administrative cum Account Assistant 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of online application is 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Research Officer?
faq.answer: The Research Officer needs MA/Msc in Social Work or M.A. /MSc. Economics, with good knowledge of basic statistical techniques and statistical software like STATA/SPSS. Preference is given to those who have completed a Ph D Degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It is preferably below 50 years for Research Officer and preferably below 40 years for Research Associate and Administrative cum Account Assistant. The notice shows NA for both intern posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for each post?
faq.answer: Research Officer gets Rs. 50,000 per month and Research Associate Rs.30,000 per month, both consolidated plus travelling expenses during data collection by public transport. Research Interns get Rs.10000/- per month and the Administrative cum Account Assistant Rs.15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google form, giving your E-mail ID and uploading Annexure-1 and your resume in a single PDF at the last tab. Applications through any other mode will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are informed over e-mail to appear for the Personal Interaction at TISS, Tuljapur off-Campus. The interview is offline and is on 04 December 2026 at 09.30AM.

faq.question: Q8. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No, the posts are to be filled on contract. The duration is five months for Research Officer, three months for Research Associate and both intern posts, and six months for Administrative cum Account Assistant.

faq.question: Q9. Are Research Interns without Honorarium paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice says "No Remuneration" for this post, with travelling expenses during data collection by public transport, food charges and accommodation charges.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA payable for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA is payable for appearing for interview. A candidate under employment must bring a No Objection Certificate from the employer.
